verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Orrick Connect page describes extranets, deal rooms, secure online file sharing, and shared client portals and dashboards. It also describes Client Share Rooms that give clients secure access to all relevant information for specific deals, and the same page cites ISO/IEC 27001-certified systems. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of matter-status tracking (only implied by "dashboards"), detail on portal features and access controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
